content: {"kind":"plan","text":"按你说的 30 分钟排了一套居家哑铃上肢：地板卧推、单臂划船、侧平举、弯举加一组上斜俯卧撑，把推、拉、肩、手臂都覆盖到，最后用肩外旋和拉伸收尾。地点用居家，没提难度就按默认入门（1 级）；哑铃重量选能标准做完 10 次、最后 2 次略吃力的。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"居家哑铃上肢 30 分","summary":"推拉兼顾的居家哑铃上肢力量课，约 25–30 分钟","goal":"strength","scene":"home","equipment":["dumbbell","chair","wall","mat"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":30,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-wall-angel","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"forearms-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-db-floor-press","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":40},{"exerciseId":"h-db-row","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":10,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":40},{"exerciseId":"h-db-lateral","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":12,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"h-db-curl","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":12,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"h-incline-pushup","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"h-side-er","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-chair-lat","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-seated-reachback","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["没提训练难度，按默认入门（1 级）安排；哑铃动作若 12 次很轻松，可换更重的哑铃或把组数加到 3 组。","组间休息 30–40 秒，动作之间换器械约 15 秒，整体大约 25–30 分钟。"],"safetyNotes":["肩、手腕或腰部不适加重就立即停止该动作，必要时咨询医生或康复师。"]}}
